theme_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & WARRIOR TACTICAL
emotional_tone: Gritty, powerful, authoritative, athletic, warrior-focused fitness & nutrition

logo_config.display_technique: Display inside rounded avatar container with dark background filter or mix-blend-mode: multiply / darken / dark circle clipping with electric gold border ring to blend seamlessly with dark mode

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider

responsive.layout: Bottom fixed navigation on mobile for Clients, vertical sticky sidebar on desktop for PT Admin. Single column stacked workout cards on mobile, 2-3 column grids on lg screens.
responsive.typography: Mobile-first type scale with clamp() or Tailwind responsive classes. Input fields with text-base (16px) to avoid iOS Safari auto-zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full overflow-x-hidden on root container. Use flex-shrink-0 for scrollable exercise series horizontal tabs.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 48px by 48px touch targets for exercise checkmarks, set counter buttons (+/-), and tab items.

grids_and_layouts.bento_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
grids_and_layouts.workout_deck: flex flex-col gap-4 sm:gap-6 w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto
grids_and_layouts.card_radius: rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/90 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all duration-200

components_architecture.Auth: Login component with Email + Password, Role selection (Client / Personal Trainer), mock login toggle for demo testing.
components_architecture.Navigation: Header with Viking Mascot logo (#METODOLAU), role badge, user profile menu, and mobile bottom tab bar (Today's Workout, Nutrition Plan, History, Profile for Client; Clients, Assign Workouts, Upload PDF, Analytics for PT Admin).
components_architecture.InteractiveWorkoutCard: Core client component: Exercise title, muscle group tag, animated demo thumbnail/GIF toggle, PT target notes, set counter rows (Set #, Previous Weight/Reps, Current Weight input, Current Reps input, Checkbox done), REST Timer countdown trigger with sound/vibration pulse effect, exercise notes input field.
components_architecture.NutritionPdfViewer: In-browser PDF viewer / simulated canvas document showing macro splits (Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fats), daily meal schedule (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks), hydration goal, and PT comments with download/print trigger.
components_architecture.PTClientManagement: PT Admin table & card view listing all clients, workout compliance stats, last active workout date, button to edit/assign workout schedule, upload new nutrition plan PDF, and message client.
components_architecture.ExerciseLibrary: Searchable list of 20+ exercises with categories (Chest, Back, Legs, Shoulders, Arms, Core) with GIF previews and target set/rep templates for PT to easily pick and build plans.
components_architecture.ProgressTracking: Visual graphs for weight lifted progress over time, completed workout streak, bodyweight logs, and macro completion ring.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, warrior-themed high-performance web app for METODO LAU in dark theme (#0A0A0D base, #F5C518 gold accent).

Use the provided logo URL (https://customer-assets-rejwkqb3.emergentagent.net/job_63076ffe-16be-493b-860d-ec786a6fd21a/artifacts/swqgbggz_IMG_2767.jpeg) in the header and auth hero screen, using dark circle overlay / mix-blend / rounded border styling so it integrates without awkward white blockiness.

Implement two user views: Client Dashboard (Interactive Workout Execution with sets/reps logging, completion checkmarks, rest timer, PT notes, nutrition PDF view, workout history) and Personal Trainer Admin Dashboard (Client roster, add new client, create/assign workout plan, upload PDF nutrition plan, monitor client logs).
Include quick account switching between PT (Admin) and Client (e.g. 'Log in as PT' vs 'Log in as Marco - Client') for easy demonstration and evaluation.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='exercise-check-0', data-testid='add-set-btn', data-testid='pt-add-client-btn').
Make the UI mobile-first with a fixed bottom navigation bar on small viewports and responsive touch targets (>= 48px).
Use Sonner for toasts (exercise completed, plan saved, PDF uploaded, rest timer finished).

Provide rich mock data with pre-filled Italian workout plans (e.g., 'Scheda A - Push & Quad', 'Scheda B - Pull & Hamstrings', 'Piano Alimentare Ipertrofia 2500 kcal') to make the experience feel authentic for an Italian personal trainer.
